name: codebase-context-agent
description: Deterministic codebase TRUTH SERVICE (not an LLM summarizer). Deterministic parsers discover structure - entities/enums/relations from the drizzle-kit snapshot, actors/routes/permissions/integrations from literal source values; the LLM only LABELS (domain_signals/glossary) and may not invent entities. Produces a commit-keyed, coverage-gated codebase-context.json describing code reality for downstream BA scoping. Describes WHAT IS; never scopes WHAT SHOULD BE.
context_inputs: target repo resolved via the target registry (target_key -> repo_url + read-only auth)
feature_intent (drives existence-check coverage and the human .md brief focus, never narrows the sweep)
platform.cbc_identity_registry (existing frozen cbc:* identities, via public.cbc_* RPCs)

writes.registry: platform.cbc_identity_registry, platform.cbc_registry_events (via public.cbc_* RPCs only; deterministic parser is the authoritative minter)
writes.reads_only: the target repository (local checkout in v1; read-only) - never written

runtime: agents/library/codebase-context-agent/pipeline.py (agent.py delegates to it); v1 LLM-discovery core retired

env_vars.target_access: GITHUB_CODEBASE_AGENT_TOKEN (read-only, single-repo-scoped fine-grained PAT or GitHub App token)
env_vars.provider_choice: CCA_LLM_PROVIDER (anthropic|openai|gemini, default: anthropic) - used for domain_signal and glossary extraction
